name: Avocado Toast with Everything Seasoning
description: Creamy avocado on toasted bread with everything bagel seasoning
instructions: Toast 2 slices of whole grain bread until golden and crisp. In a small bowl, mash 1/2 avocado with 1 tbsp lemon juice, salt, and pepper until mostly smooth but still slightly chunky. Spread mashed avocado evenly over toast. Sprinkle generously with everything bagel seasoning. For extra protein, top with 2 sliced hard-boiled eggs or smoked salmon. Garnish with red pepper flakes and fresh microgreens. Serve immediately.

name: Berry Protein Smoothie Bowl
description: Thick smoothie bowl topped with fresh fruits and granola
instructions: Add 1.5 scoops vanilla protein powder, 1 frozen banana, 1 cup mixed frozen berries, 1/2 cup Greek yogurt, and 1/4 cup almond milk to a high-speed blender. Blend on high until thick and creamy, adding more almond milk if needed to achieve desired consistency. Pour into a bowl and arrange toppings in rows: 1/4 cup granola, 1/2 cup fresh berries, 1 tbsp chia seeds, 1 tbsp coconut flakes, and fresh mint leaves. Drizzle with 1 tsp honey if desired.

name: Breakfast Burrito
description: Scrambled eggs, black beans, and cheese in a whole wheat tortilla
instructions: Scramble eggs with black beans and cheese. Roll in tortilla with salsa and avocado.

name: Chia Seed Pudding
description: Creamy pudding made with chia seeds, milk, and protein powder
instructions: Mix chia seeds, milk, and protein powder. Refrigerate overnight. Top with fruits.

name: Cottage Cheese Bowl
description: High-protein cottage cheese with fruits, nuts, and honey
instructions: Top cottage cheese with sliced fruits, nuts, and drizzle with honey.

name: Egg Muffins
description: Baked egg muffins with vegetables and cheese, perfect for meal prep
instructions: Whisk eggs with vegetables and cheese. Pour into muffin tin and bake until set.

name: Greek Yogurt Parfait
description: Creamy Greek yogurt layered with fruits and high-fiber granola
instructions: In a clear glass or bowl, layer 1/2 cup of Greek yogurt on the bottom. Add a layer of mixed berries, followed by another layer of yogurt. Sprinkle high-fiber granola over the top. Drizzle honey evenly across the parfait. Serve chilled with a long spoon to enjoy all layers together.

name: Overnight Protein Oats
description: No-cook oatmeal soaked overnight with protein powder and fruits
instructions: In a mason jar or container, combine rolled oats, protein powder, milk, and chia seeds. Stir well until protein powder is fully dissolved. Cover and refrigerate overnight for at least 8 hours. In the morning, stir well and top with fresh berries and chopped walnuts. Can be eaten cold or warmed in the microwave for 30 seconds.

name: Protein Pancakes
description: Fluffy pancakes made with protein powder and topped with berries
instructions: Mix protein powder with pancake mix. Cook pancakes and top with berries and maple syrup.

name: Protein Power Oatmeal
description: Hearty oatmeal packed with protein and fiber for sustained energy
instructions: Combine rolled oats and 1 cup of water or milk in a microwave-safe bowl. Microwave on high for 2-3 minutes until oats are cooked and creamy (or cook on stovetop for 5 minutes). Stir in protein powder, mixing well to combine. Add chia seeds and stir for 1 minute until they absorb some liquid. Top with fresh berries and chopped nuts. Serve immediately while warm.

name: Savory Oatmeal Bowl
description: Savory oatmeal topped with egg, cheese, and vegetables
instructions: In a saucepan, bring 1 cup water or vegetable broth to a boil. Add 1/2 cup rolled oats and reduce heat to medium-low. Cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until oats are tender and creamy. Stir in 1 tbsp nutritional yeast, 1/4 tsp garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Transfer to a bowl and top with a fried egg, 2 oz shredded cheddar cheese, sautéed mushrooms, and fresh chives. The savory flavors make this a satisfying alternative to sweet oatmeal.

name: Smoked Salmon Bagel
description: Classic bagel with smoked salmon, cream cheese, and capers
instructions: Toast 1 whole grain bagel until golden and crisp. Spread 2 tbsp cream cheese evenly on both halves. Layer 3 oz smoked salmon on one half. Top with thinly sliced red onion, 1 tbsp capers, and fresh dill sprigs. Squeeze fresh lemon juice over salmon. Season with black pepper. Close sandwich and cut in half. Serve immediately while bagel is still warm.

name: Spinach and Feta Omelette
description: Fluffy omelette filled with spinach, feta cheese, and tomatoes
instructions: Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Add 2 cups fresh spinach and cook until wilted (1-2 minutes). Remove spinach and set aside. In a bowl, whisk 4 eggs with 2 tbsp milk, salt, and pepper. Pour eggs into the same skillet and cook, gently pushing cooked portions toward center and tilting pan to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath (2-3 minutes). When eggs are mostly set but still slightly moist on top, sprinkle wilted spinach, 2 oz crumbled feta cheese, and 1/4 cup diced tomatoes over one half. Fold other half over filling and cook for 1 more minute. Slide onto plate and serve immediately.

name: Tofu Scramble
description: Plant-based scrambled tofu with vegetables and turmeric
instructions: Crumble tofu and sauté with vegetables, turmeric, and nutritional yeast.

name: Veggie Scramble Wrap
description: Fluffy eggs with vegetables and cheese wrapped in a whole grain tortilla
instructions: Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat with a little oil or cooking spray. Crack 3 eggs into the pan, add a splash of milk or water, and whisk lightly. Add spinach, diced bell pepper, and onion. Scramble with a spatula for 3-4 minutes until eggs are set but still moist. Stir in shredded cheese and remove from heat. Warm the tortilla for 10 seconds in a dry pan or microwave. Scoop the egg mixture into the center of the tortilla, add sliced avocado, and roll tightly from one side to the other. Cut in half diagonally before serving.

name: Baked Ziti
description: Ziti pasta with meat sauce and cheese baked until bubbly
instructions: Cook ziti and mix with meat sauce and cheese. Bake until golden and bubbly.

name: Beef Tacos
description: Seasoned ground beef tacos with all the fixings
instructions: Brown beef with taco seasoning. Serve in tortillas with cheese, lettuce, and tomatoes.

name: Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry
description: Classic Chinese takeout made healthy at home
instructions: Slice 1 lb beef sirloin into thin strips against the grain. In a bowl, toss beef with 1 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tbsp cornstarch. Heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a wok over high heat. Add beef and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until browned. Remove beef and set aside. Add 1 tbsp oil to wok, add 3 cloves minced garlic and 1 tbsp ginger, stir-fry for 30 seconds. Add 4 cups broccoli florets and 1 sliced red bell pepper, stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until crisp-tender. Return beef to wok with sauce mixture (2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tsp sesame oil). Toss for 1 minute. Serve over brown rice.

name: Black Bean and Sweet Potato Bowl
description: Plant-based power bowl with black beans and roasted sweet potato
instructions: Roast sweet potato cubes. Serve with black beans, corn, avocado, and lime-cilantro dressing.

name: Braised Chicken with Root Vegetables
description: Slow-braised chicken with carrots, parsnips, and aromatic herbs
instructions: Cut chicken thighs into serving pieces (bone-in or bone-out). Pat chicken dry with paper towels. Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large Dutch oven or heavy pot over medium-high heat. Add chicken pieces, skin-side down, and cook for 5-6 minutes until golden brown. Flip and cook for another 3-4 minutes until browned on all sides. Remove chicken and set aside. Reduce heat to medium. Add diced onion, carrots, and parsnips to the pot. Cook for 6-7 minutes until vegetables begin to soften. Add tomato paste, 2 tablespoons turmeric, minced garlic, and fresh thyme. Stir for 2 minutes until fragrant. Pour in 2 cups chicken broth and 1/2 cup white wine (or additional broth). Return chicken to the pot. Bring to a simmer, reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 45-55 minutes until chicken is tender and vegetables are cooked. Remove chicken and vegetables, increase heat to high, and simmer cooking liquid for 5-8 minutes until reduced by half. Season with salt and pepper. Serve chicken and vegetables with the reduced sauce spooned over top. Serve with boiled potatoes or crusty bread.

name: Chicken Enchiladas
description: Rolled tortillas with chicken, cheese, and enchilada sauce
instructions: Roll chicken and cheese in tortillas. Top with sauce and bake until bubbly.

name: Chicken Parmesan
description: Breaded chicken breast with marinara sauce and melted cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Set up 3 shallow bowls: one with flour, one with 2 beaten eggs, and one with breadcrumbs mixed with 1/4 cup parmesan. Season chicken breasts with salt and pepper. Dredge each chicken breast in flour, shaking off excess. Dip into eggs, letting excess drip off. Press into breadcrumb-parmesan mixture, coating well. Heat olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken and cook for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown. Remove chicken from pan and set aside. In the same pan (without cleaning), pour marinara sauce and bring to a simmer. Arrange chicken back in the pan, spoon sauce over the top. Sprinkle remaining parmesan and mozzarella over chicken. Transfer to oven and bake for 15-20 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly. Meanwhile, cook pasta according to package directions. Serve chicken and sauce over pasta with extra parmesan.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
description: Tender chicken in creamy tomato sauce with basmati rice
instructions: Marinate and grill chicken. Make creamy tomato sauce. Simmer chicken in sauce. Serve with rice.

name: Chicken and Vegetable Curry Stew
description: Aromatic curry-style chicken stew with root vegetables and turmeric
instructions: Cut chicken into serving pieces. Heat 2 tablespoons coconut oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat. Add chicken pieces and cook for 6-8 minutes until lightly browned on all sides. Remove chicken and set aside. In the same pot, add diced onion, carrots, celery root, and cubed sweet potatoes. Cook for 6-7 minutes until vegetables begin to soften. Add minced garlic, grated ginger, turmeric, cumin, and coriander. Stir for 2 minutes until fragrant. Stir in 2 tablespoons tomato paste and cook for 1 minute. Return chicken to the pot. Pour in coconut milk and 2 cups chicken broth. Add bay leaves and bring to a simmer. Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 40-45 minutes until chicken is tender and vegetables are cooked. Remove bay leaves. Stir in fresh spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted. Season with salt and pepper. Serve hot over basmati rice or with naan bread.
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice or naan bread

name: Coconut Curry with Tofu
description: Creamy Thai curry with tofu and vegetables
instructions: Press 1 block firm tofu to remove excess water, then cut into 1-inch cubes. Heat 1 tbsp coconut oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add 1 diced onion and cook for 5 minutes until soft. Add 2 cloves minced garlic and 1 tbsp grated ginger, cook for 1 minute. Add 1 tbsp red curry paste and cook for 30 seconds. Add 1 can (13.5 oz) coconut milk, 1 cup vegetable broth, 2 cups mixed vegetables (broccoli, bell peppers, snap peas), and tofu cubes. Simmer for 10-15 minutes until vegetables are tender. Season with soy sauce and lime juice. Serve over jasmine rice.

name: Cod with Garlic and Herbs
description: Baked cod with garlic, herbs, and lemon served with roasted vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Pat cod fillets dry and season with salt and pepper. Mix minced garlic, chopped parsley, lemon zest, olive oil, and oregano in a small bowl. Coat each cod fillet with garlic-herb mixture. Place cod on a baking sheet. Arrange chopped carrots, zucchini, and red onion around fish. Drizzle vegetables with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Bake for 15-18 minutes until cod is opaque and flakes easily. Squeeze fresh lemon over fish before serving.

name: Eggplant Parmesan
description: Breaded eggplant with marinara sauce and melted cheese
instructions: Bread and fry eggplant slices. Layer with sauce and cheese. Bake until bubbly.

name: Filipino Adobo with Chicken
description: Tangy Filipino chicken stewed in soy and vinegar
instructions: In a pot, combine 1 lb chicken pieces, 1/2 cup soy sauce, 1/2 cup vinegar, 1/2 cup water, 4 cloves garlic, 1 bay leaf, and 1 tsp black peppercorns. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes. Remove chicken and fry in 2 tbsp oil until golden. Return to pot and simmer for 10 more minutes until sauce reduces and thickens. Serve over steamed rice.

name: Grilled Pork Tenderloin
description: Juicy grilled pork tenderloin with apple glaze and roasted vegetables
instructions: Trim 8 oz pork tenderloin of excess fat and silver skin. In a small bowl, mix 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp apple cider vinegar, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 1 minced garlic clove, salt, and pepper to make marinade. Place pork in a resealable bag with marinade and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes (up to 4 hours). Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Remove pork from marinade and grill for 12-15 minutes, turning occasionally, until internal temperature reaches 145°F. Let rest for 5 minutes before slicing. Meanwhile, toss 2 cups mixed vegetables (broccoli, bell peppers, zucchini) with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Grill vegetables for 8-10 minutes until tender and charred. Serve sliced pork with grilled vegetables.

name: Honey Garlic Glazed Salmon
description: Salmon fillets with sweet honey garlic glaze
instructions: Mix honey, garlic, and soy sauce. Glaze salmon. Bake at 400°F for 12-15 minutes. Broil for 2 minutes to caramelize. Serve with steamed vegetables.

name: Indian Butter Chicken
description: Creamy tomato-based curry with tender chicken
instructions: Marinate and grill chicken. Make sauce with tomatoes, cream, garam masala, and butter. Add chicken and simmer. Serve with naan and rice.

name: Korean Bibimbap with Beef
description: Korean rice bowl with seasoned beef, fresh vegetables, gochujang sauce, and a fried egg
instructions: Prepare steamed jasmine rice. Thinly slice beef and marinate in soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic, and sugar for 15 minutes. Stir-fry beef until browned (4-5 minutes). Blanch spinach, julienne carrots, zucchini, and cucumber. Steam bean sprouts. Sauté each vegetable separately with sesame oil and salt. Arrange rice in a bowl, top with beef, vegetables, and a fried egg. Serve with gochujang sauce on side. Mix everything together before eating.

name: Korean Kimchi Stew
description: Hearty stew with kimchi, tofu, pork, and vegetables
instructions: Cut kimchi into bite-sized pieces. Slice pork belly thinly. Drain and cut tofu into cubes. Heat a pot over medium heat, add sesame oil and pork. Cook pork until fat renders (5 minutes). Add garlic and kimchi, stir-fry for 3 minutes. Add kimchi juice, water or anchovy broth, and gochugaru (Korean chili flakes). Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to medium-low. Simmer for 15 minutes to develop flavors. Add tofu cubes, zucchini, and green onions. Simmer for another 10 minutes. Season with fish sauce if needed. Serve hot in a bowl, garnished with green onions.

name: Lamb Chops with Mint
description: Grilled lamb chops with mint sauce and roasted vegetables
instructions: Grill lamb chops. Make mint sauce. Serve with roasted vegetables.

name: Lemon Herb Grilled Chicken
description: Juicy grilled chicken with bright lemon and herbs
instructions: In a bowl, mix 1/4 cup olive oil, juice of 1 lemon, 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped), 1 tbsp fresh thyme, 2 cloves minced garlic, salt, and pepper. Add 4 chicken breasts and marinate for at least 30 minutes (up to 4 hours). Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Grill chicken for 6-8 minutes per side until internal temperature reaches 165°F. Let rest for 5 minutes before slicing. Serve with grilled vegetables and a side of quinoa.

name: Mediterranean Chicken Roast
description: Roasted chicken with Mediterranean vegetables and olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Cut vegetables into large chunks: zucchini, bell peppers, red onion, and cherry tomatoes. Toss vegetables with 3 tablespoons olive oil, dried oregano, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Spread on a large baking sheet in a single layer. Season chicken thighs with salt, pepper, and a little olive oil. Arrange chicken on top of vegetables. Roast for 35-40 minutes, turning chicken halfway through, until skin is crispy and chicken reaches 165°F (74°C) internally. Remove from oven and let rest for 5 minutes. Squeeze fresh lemon over chicken and vegetables. Serve with crusty bread or over quinoa.

name: Moroccan Chicken Tagine with Preserved Lemons
description: Slow-cooked chicken with preserved lemons and olives
instructions: Brown chicken in tagine pot. Add onions, garlic, spices, preserved lemons, and olives. Simmer slowly until chicken is tender.

name: Moussaka
description: Greek layered casserole with eggplant, meat sauce, and béchamel
instructions: Layer eggplant with meat sauce. Top with béchamel and bake until golden.

name: Mushroom Risotto
description: Creamy arborio rice with sautéed mushrooms and parmesan cheese
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add 1 finely chopped onion and cook for 5 minutes until soft. Add 2 cloves minced garlic and cook for 1 minute. Add 2 cups sliced mushrooms and cook until golden and tender (5-7 minutes). Add 1 cup arborio rice and stir for 2 minutes until grains are coated and translucent. Add 1/2 cup white wine and cook, stirring constantly, until absorbed. Begin adding 4 cups warm vegetable broth one ladle at a time, stirring constantly and waiting for each addition to be absorbed before adding the next. Continue for 20-25 minutes until rice is creamy and al dente. Remove from heat and stir in 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese and 2 tbsp butter. Season with salt and pepper. Let rest for 2 minutes before serving.

name: Paella
description: Spanish rice dish with seafood, chicken, and saffron
instructions: Sauté seafood and chicken. Add rice and saffron-infused broth. Simmer until rice is tender.

name: Pork Tenderloin with Apple Cider Glaze
description: Roasted pork tenderloin with sweet apple glaze
instructions: Season pork and sear on all sides. Roast at 400°F for 20-25 minutes. Make glaze with apple cider and maple syrup. Brush on pork and serve.

name: Ratatouille
description: French vegetable stew with eggplant, zucchini, and tomatoes
instructions: Layer sliced vegetables and bake with herbs until tender. Serve with crusty bread.

name: Salmon with Roasted Vegetables
description: Omega-rich salmon with fiber-packed roasted vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Pat salmon fillets dry and season with salt, pepper, olive oil, herbs, and garlic. Place broccoli florets and cubed sweet potato on a baking sheet. Drizzle vegetables with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Arrange salmon on top. Bake for 15-20 minutes until salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork, and vegetables are tender. Squeeze fresh lemon over the dish before serving.

name: Shrimp Pad Thai
description: Stir-fried rice noodles with shrimp, eggs, and peanut sauce
instructions: Soak noodles. Stir-fry shrimp and vegetables. Add noodles and sauce. Toss with peanuts.

name: Vegetarian Chili
description: Hearty three-bean chili with vegetables and spices
instructions: Sauté vegetables and beans. Add tomatoes and spices. Simmer for 1 hour. Top with cheese.

name: Asian Chicken Lettuce Wraps
description: Crispy lettuce cups filled with seasoned chicken and vegetables
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add 6 oz ground chicken and cook, breaking up with a spoon, until browned (5-6 minutes). Add 2 cloves minced garlic, 1 tsp grated ginger, and 1/4 cup diced water chestnuts. Cook for 2 minutes until fragrant. In a small bowl, mix 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, and 1 tsp honey. Add sauce to chicken and stir until coated. Remove from heat and stir in 2 sliced green onions and 1/4 cup chopped cilantro. Spoon mixture into butter lettuce cups and serve immediately.

name: BBQ Pulled Chicken Sandwich
description: Tender BBQ chicken on a brioche bun with coleslaw
instructions: Slow cook chicken in BBQ sauce until tender. Toast brioche buns. Assemble sandwiches with pulled chicken, coleslaw, and pickles.

name: Chicken Caesar Wrap
description: Grilled chicken, romaine, and caesar dressing in a whole wheat wrap
instructions: Toss chicken with caesar dressing. Add romaine and wrap in tortilla with parmesan.

name: Chicken Noodle Soup
description: Comforting soup with chicken, vegetables, and egg noodles
instructions: Simmer chicken broth with chicken and vegetables. Add noodles and cook until tender.

name: Chicken Shawarma Bowl
description: Spiced chicken shawarma over rice with garlic sauce
instructions: Season chicken with shawarma spices and grill until cooked. Slice chicken. Serve over rice with garlic sauce, pickles, tomatoes, and parsley.

name: Curried Chickpea Bowl
description: Aromatic curried chickpeas over basmati rice
instructions: Sauté onions and garlic. Add spices and chickpeas. Simmer until flavorful. Serve over basmati rice with yogurt and cilantro.

name: Egg Salad Sandwich
description: Creamy egg salad with herbs on whole grain bread
instructions: Mix chopped eggs with mayo, mustard, and herbs. Serve on bread with lettuce.

name: Falafel Wrap
description: Crispy falafel with tahini sauce and vegetables in whole wheat wrap
instructions: Warm falafel and place in wrap with tahini sauce, vegetables, and pickles.

name: Greek Chicken Gyro
description: Seasoned chicken with tzatziki sauce in pita bread
instructions: Cook seasoned chicken strips. Serve in pita with tzatziki, tomatoes, and onions.

name: Grilled Chicken Salad
description: Lean grilled chicken over mixed greens with high-fiber vegetables
instructions: Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high heat. Season chicken breasts with salt, pepper, and a little olive oil. Grill chicken for 6-7 minutes per side until internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C) and chicken has nice grill marks. Let chicken rest for 5 minutes, then slice into strips. Meanwhile, toss mixed greens with halved cherry tomatoes, sliced cucumber, and pumpkin seeds. Arrange greens on plates, top with sliced chicken, and drizzle with your favorite olive oil vinaigrette. Serve immediately.

name: Korean Beef Bowl with Fermented Vegetables
description: Quick ground beef bowl with kimchi, pickled vegetables, and sesame
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat with sesame oil. Add ground beef, breaking it up with a spoon. Cook until browned (6-8 minutes). Add minced garlic, ginger, and soy sauce, stirring for 1 minute. Add gochujang and mix well. Remove from heat. In a bowl, layer steamed rice, beef mixture, kimchi, and quick-pickled cucumber and radish. Top with a fried egg and sprinkle sesame seeds. Drizzle with extra gochujang if desired. Mix thoroughly before eating.

name: Lentil and Vegetable Soup
description: Hearty lentil soup packed with fiber and plant-based protein
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add diced onion, carrot, and celery, cooking for 5-6 minutes until softened. Add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add rinsed red lentils, vegetable broth, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 25-30 minutes until lentils are tender. Add chopped spinach and stir until wilted (about 2 minutes). Season with salt, pepper, and dried thyme. Serve hot, optionally with a squeeze of lemon and a drizzle of olive oil.

name: Mediterranean Quinoa Salad
description: Fresh quinoa salad with Mediterranean vegetables and feta cheese
instructions: Cook 1 cup quinoa according to package directions and let cool completely. In a large bowl, combine cooled quinoa, 1 cup cherry tomatoes (halved), 1/2 cucumber (diced), 1/4 cup red onion (thinly sliced), 1/2 cup Kalamata olives, and 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese. In a small bowl, whisk together 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1 tsp dried oregano, salt, and pepper to make dressing. Pour dressing over salad and toss gently to combine. Let salad marinate for 15 minutes before serving. Garnish with fresh parsley.

name: Mexican Chipotle Chicken Bowl
description: Spiced chicken in chipotle sauce over rice
instructions: Season chicken with chipotle and grill until cooked. Slice and mix with chipotle sauce. Serve over rice with black beans and corn.

name: Pasta Carbonara
description: Creamy pasta with bacon, eggs, and parmesan cheese
instructions: Cook fettuccine or spaghetti in salted water according to package directions until al dente, then drain well, reserving 1/2 cup of pasta water. While pasta cooks, fry bacon in a large pan over medium heat until crispy (4-5 minutes), then remove and set aside on paper towels. In a bowl, whisk eggs with grated parmesan and plenty of black pepper. Remove pan from heat and add a splash of olive oil. Immediately pour in drained pasta (not the reserved water yet), tossing to coat slightly. Add bacon and egg-cheese mixture to the pasta, tossing vigorously off heat to create a creamy sauce using the hot pasta. If too thick, add reserved pasta water 1 tablespoon at a time until smooth. Serve immediately with extra parmesan and black pepper.

name: Quinoa Power Bowl
description: Nutrient-dense quinoa bowl with roasted vegetables and chickpeas
instructions: Cook quinoa and let cool. Top with roasted vegetables, chickpeas, feta, and tahini dressing.

name: Salmon Niçoise Salad
description: Classic French salad with grilled salmon and boiled eggs
instructions: Grill salmon and flake. Boil eggs and potatoes. Arrange greens, green beans, olives, tomatoes, and hard-boiled eggs. Top with salmon and vinaigrette.

name: Shrimp Scampi Pasta
description: Garlic shrimp with pasta in white wine and butter sauce
instructions: Cook pasta. Sauté shrimp in garlic, butter, and white wine. Toss with pasta and parsley.

name: Spaghetti Bolognese
description: Classic pasta with rich meat sauce and parmesan cheese
instructions: Cook spaghetti in salted water according to package directions until al dente (usually 8-10 minutes), then drain well. While pasta cooks, heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add diced onion and cook for 5 minutes until translucent. Add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add ground beef and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned (5-7 minutes). Pour in tomato sauce and add dried basil and oregano. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes to develop flavors. Season with salt and pepper. Serve sauce over spaghetti with parmesan cheese sprinkled on top.

name: Stuffed Bell Peppers
description: Bell peppers stuffed with ground turkey, rice, and tomatoes
instructions: Cook turkey and rice. Stuff peppers and bake until tender. Top with cheese.

name: Sushi Bowl
description: Deconstructed sushi with salmon, avocado, and vegetables over rice
instructions: Layer rice with salmon, avocado, cucumber, and vegetables. Drizzle with soy sauce and sriracha.

name: Thai Peanut Noodle Bowl
description: Rice noodles with peanut sauce and grilled chicken
instructions: Cook rice noodles. Grill chicken and slice. Whisk peanut sauce. Combine noodles, chicken, vegetables, and peanut sauce. Top with peanuts and cilantro.

name: Tuna Salad Sandwich
description: Classic tuna salad with celery and onion on whole grain bread
instructions: Mix tuna with mayo, celery, and onion. Serve on whole grain bread with lettuce.

name: Turkey and Avocado Wrap
description: Lean turkey with avocado and vegetables in a high-fiber wrap
instructions: Spread hummus on wrap, layer with turkey, avocado, and vegetables. Roll tightly and slice.

name: Vietnamese Pho with Beef
description: Traditional Vietnamese noodle soup with beef and herbs
instructions: In a large pot, bring 6 cups beef broth to a simmer. Add 1 star anise, 1 cinnamon stick, 2 cloves, and 1 slice ginger. Simmer for 15 minutes. Cook 6 oz rice noodles according to package directions. In bowls, arrange 4 oz thinly sliced beef, cooked noodles, bean sprouts, and basil. Pour hot broth over beef (it will cook from the heat). Top with sliced green onions, cilantro, and a squeeze of lime. Serve with hoisin sauce and sriracha.

name: Almond Butter Toast with Banana
description: Simple toast with almond butter and sliced banana
instructions: Toast bread. Spread almond butter generously. Top with sliced banana and sprinkle with cinnamon. Optional: add honey drizzle.

name: Apple and Peanut Butter Plate
description: Simple post-workout snack with apple and peanut butter
instructions: Slice apple into wedges. Serve with generous portion of peanut butter. Optional: sprinkle with cinnamon or granola for extra texture.

name: Avocado Toast with Egg
description: Whole grain toast with mashed avocado and poached egg
instructions: Toast whole grain bread. Mash avocado with lime and season. Top with poached or fried egg. Sprinkle with red pepper flakes.

name: Banana Protein Smoothie
description: Creamy banana smoothie with protein powder and peanut butter
instructions: Blend banana, protein powder, peanut butter, and milk until smooth.

name: Berry Recovery Smoothie Bowl
description: Thick smoothie bowl topped with protein-rich ingredients
instructions: Add 1.5 scoops vanilla protein powder, 1 cup mixed frozen berries, 1 frozen banana, 1/2 cup Greek yogurt, and 1/4 cup almond milk to a high-speed blender. Blend until thick and creamy, adding more almond milk if needed. Pour into a bowl and arrange toppings: 2 tbsp granola, 1 tbsp hemp seeds, 1 tbsp almond butter, 1/2 cup fresh berries, and fresh mint. The antioxidant-rich berries help reduce inflammation, while protein powder supports muscle repair.

name: Chicken and Rice Recovery Bowl
description: Simple bowl with chicken, brown rice, and vegetables
instructions: Cook 1/2 cup brown rice according to package directions. Season 6 oz chicken breast with salt, pepper, and garlic powder. Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook chicken for 5-6 minutes per side until cooked through. Let rest for 3 minutes, then dice. Steam 1 cup mixed vegetables (broccoli, carrots) for 3-4 minutes. Assemble bowl with brown rice, diced chicken, and steamed vegetables. Drizzle with 1 tbsp soy sauce and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

name: Chocolate Milk
description: Classic recovery drink with optimal protein-carb ratio
instructions: Drink chocolate milk within 30 minutes of workout for optimal recovery.

name: Chocolate Protein Recovery Shake
description: Optimal recovery shake with protein, carbs, and essential nutrients
instructions: Blend all ingredients until smooth. Consume within 30 minutes of workout completion.

name: Cottage Cheese with Fruit
description: High-protein cottage cheese with fresh fruit and nuts
instructions: Top cottage cheese with sliced fruit and nuts. Drizzle with honey.

name: Greek Yogurt Power Bowl
description: Protein-packed yogurt bowl with fruits, nuts, and seeds
instructions: In a bowl, place 2 cups plain Greek yogurt. Top with 1 cup mixed berries (strawberries, blueberries, raspberries), 2 tbsp chopped walnuts, 1 tbsp pumpkin seeds, and 1 tbsp ground flaxseed. Drizzle with 1 tbsp honey and sprinkle with cinnamon. For enhanced recovery, add 1/2 scoop vanilla protein powder to the yogurt and mix well before adding toppings. The casein protein in Greek yogurt provides slow-release amino acids, while berries offer antioxidants to reduce exercise-induced oxidative stress.

name: Greek Yogurt with Berries and Honey
description: Quick protein-rich snack with antioxidant berries
instructions: Mix Greek yogurt with berries and drizzle with honey. Add granola for extra carbs.

name: Hard-Boiled Eggs and Avocado
description: Simple protein-rich snack with healthy fats
instructions: Serve hard-boiled eggs with sliced avocado and seasoning.

name: Hummus and Veggie Plate
description: Protein-rich hummus with fresh vegetables and pita
instructions: Arrange hummus, fresh vegetables, and pita bread on plate. Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with paprika. Serve immediately.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Smoothie
description: Creamy protein smoothie with peanut butter and banana
instructions: Blend all ingredients until smooth. Add ice for thickness. Drink within 30 minutes of workout.

name: Protein Energy Balls
description: No-bake energy balls with protein powder and dates
instructions: Mix all ingredients and roll into balls. Refrigerate for 30 minutes.

name: Rice Cakes with Peanut Butter
description: Quick carb-protein combo with rice cakes and peanut butter
instructions: Spread peanut butter on rice cakes and top with banana slices.

name: Roasted Chickpeas and Nuts
description: Crunchy roasted chickpeas with mixed nuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Drain and rinse 1 can chickpeas, pat dry thoroughly. Toss with 1 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 tsp smoked paprika, 1/4 tsp garlic powder, and salt. Spread on a baking sheet and roast for 20-25 minutes until crispy. Let cool slightly, then toss with 1/4 cup mixed nuts (almonds, walnuts, pecans). The roasted chickpeas provide plant-based protein and fiber, while nuts offer healthy fats and additional protein.

name: Salmon and Quinoa Bowl
description: Baked salmon with quinoa and roasted vegetables
instructions: Bake salmon at 400°F for 12-15 minutes. Cook quinoa. Roast vegetables. Assemble bowl with salmon, quinoa, vegetables, and lemon vinaigrette.

name: Tuna Salad Crackers
description: Tuna salad served on whole grain crackers
instructions: Mix tuna with Greek yogurt and seasonings. Serve on crackers.

name: Turkey and Avocado Recovery Wrap
description: Lean protein wrap with healthy fats and vegetables
instructions: Lay a whole grain tortilla flat. Spread 2 tbsp hummus evenly over the surface. Layer 6 oz sliced turkey breast, 1/2 sliced avocado, 1 cup mixed greens, sliced tomato, and thinly sliced red onion. For extra recovery, add 1 tbsp pumpkin seeds. Roll tightly, tucking in the sides as you roll. Cut in half and serve immediately. The combination of lean protein, healthy fats, and vegetables provides balanced macronutrients for optimal recovery.
